scope: All git-tracked Markdown, inline links, explicit reference definitions/usages and HTML href/src outside fenced blocks. Heading/explicit-ID fragments for Markdown. No external URLs, shortcuts, inline-code paths, command execution or MDX/TSX certification.
parserLimits: Bounded Markdown parser; heading slug approximates GitHub. Findings require source review; missing-anchor is not automatically a broken link. Absolute website routes explicitly unchecked.
